# Introduction

The skills for the repository live here.
To use the skill use / and provide the skill name.

## Updating the Practitioners Calls Archive

Use `/update-practitioners-calls-archive` to find published recordings newer than the latest archived session and add verified missing calls to the [Practitioners Calls Archive](../../docs/overview/practitioners-calls-archive.md).

You can also provide a date range, session topic, or recording URL to narrow the search or add an older missing session. The [skill](./update-practitioners-calls-archive/SKILL.md) checks for duplicates, writes source-grounded summaries, updates the table of contents and article date, and reports recordings that need more evidence before they can be added.
